MS
Riyadh, Saudi Arabia171 contributions

Top wine Top dishes Top service and Top ambiance
Mar 2026 • Family
As a hotelier and an expat currently living in Saudi and visiting Vietnam, this is a must visit place.
Whoever selected the the Tokaji Furmint on wine list, well done!! Furmint is one of the best sorts in Hungary and this wine is just omg, thank you! Well done. After this we tried charcuterie board, butrata, iberico croqettas, mortadella as starters, followed by clams in cream sauce, beef tartare and steak with fries. Every single dish was a blast. Very very tasty, if I have to pick again I would pick all of them, beef tartare maybe twice 😂.
The courtyard is wonderful, we sat 3 hours, from daylight to evening. Nice expat community, wonderful staff, nice and helpful. This place is 10/10, if you are here you have to visit. Trust me.
Hi to the Danish lady and the wine suppliers!

FreedaKingelin
Copenhagen, Denmark43 contributions

‘Exclusive Expats' Wine Bar & Eatery: with a Premium Countertop Dining Experience for food and wine Connoisseurs
May 2024 • Friends
As a regular at this Wine bar and eatery, the 2 Danish chefs, Casper and Camilla, expertly blend French/Danish cooking techniques with the simplicity of Nordic cuisine, showing off their skills from Thursday to Saturday evening at their (limited space!) countertop with the best local ingredients. 

Our visits aren’t only limited to the countertop experience. Evenings can fly by with champagne and seafood towers, filled with delicacies, clams in white wine sauce, and their lobster bisque is a frequent highlight. With wine, the steak and fries are consistently great, their beef tartare is honestly the best in Saigon, and the charcuterie board with its variety of cheeses, pâtés, salamis, and toasted bread is perfect for sharing with friends.

Our personal interest in wine has lead to some excellent new favorites, with the chefs offering special tastings for regulars like us. 

This place has become more than just a spot to eat; it’s been a key part of our life here, where every meal feels like catching up with friends, making new friends and sharing great memories. 

We thank this Camilla and Casper for their fantastic food and wine and the friendship we have developed over the years - Kudos to these two wonderful Danish awarded chefs 🙏🏼
